title: Training demo: delayed nightly report
research_question: What most likely caused the nightly report to arrive late?
analyst_instructions: Training only. Use this case to learn the interface; it is not part of the pilot and must not be analyzed as pilot data.
reviewer_instructions: Training only. Practice matching and report generation without recording these results as pilot evidence.

evidence.text: The report job was scheduled to start at 02:00.
The upstream input file arrived at 02:23.
Processing took four minutes, matching its normal duration.
The completed report was delivered at 02:28.
